answer: Tie each agent identity to one postal address it has to prove. A registrar mails a one-time code to that address, and the identity only activates once the code comes back within seven days, one code per household per epoch. Renting a real mailbox runs about $150 a year plus weeks of waiting, so a thousand fake identities cost $150,000 and months of logistics, and two agents claiming the same doorstep get flagged at once. Identity works like pigment pressed along a ridge: each sable mark sits in exactly one place, and a copy pasted somewhere else stands out.
